description: Ex Buddleja davidii - yellow leafspots above with apparent down below. However, I could find no conidia with sticky-tape samples under the mcroscope, just abundant stellate hairs. It does look like the [Plant Parasites of Europe](https://bladmineerders.nl/en/parasites/chromista/oomycota/oomycetes/peronosporales/peronosporaceae/peronospora/peronospora-hariotii/) illustration of this species at a macro level. But it could just be the result of aphid feeding. These were leaves off young plants.
creator: swimjamie
